content:
Overview

Abilene is a city in TX with a population of 125,000. Frontier city with three universities, the Abilene Zoo, and the Paramount Theatre. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.8.
